Maya: pulling together a capacity plan for Dedicated pools for the new 70B bring-up. Need a geo latency matrix (us-west1 / us-east1 / eu-west1) across H100 + A100, and recommended concurrency targets + autoscale headroom. Also want kernel notes (flash-attn variants) and quant impact (fp16/q4f16/int8).

Ryan: I ran a short sweep yesterday, quick paste of 50-token gen, batch=1 runs (warm cache unless noted). numbers rough but actionable: ```
region,gpu,format,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tps_per_gpu
us-west1,H100,fp16,22,80,180,140
us-west1,H100,int8,24,95,240,180
us-east1,A100,fp16,28,110,300,100
eu-west1,A100,int8,30,130,360,130
```

Sophie: nice. note these were single-request latency runs; throughput behavior at higher concurrency changes kernels picked. flash-attn2 reduces p99 by ~15-20% on H100 for this model.

Anil: adding packing_factor and kv-cache notes: when KV warmup happens p99 jumps for first few requests. recommend prefix caching for habitual prompts. packing_factor ~0.85 on H100 int8 for steady-state batching.

Infra-bot: load-test summary uploaded: https://internal.redwood/tests/212456/summary (artifact id: 212456/a).

load-test-bot: run 212456-quick-sweep finished. tail spikes observed in us-east1 A100 fp16 between 2200-2300rps (GC-like pauses in host process). Logs at /s3/bench/212456/logs.tar.gz

Maya: ok, concrete ask: target p99 <= 250ms for Dedicated route. how many GPUs per region to sustain 10k qps across regions (balanced by traffic: us-west 45%, us-east 35%, eu 20%) with 30% baseline headroom and 20% burst runway? show per-region GPU counts and per-GPU concurrency target.

Ryan: quick back-of-envelope: use tps_per_gpu from sweep, then apply safety buffers. calculations:
- start with effective tps_per_gpu = measured_tps * 0.9 (kernel/packing delta)
- apply baseline headroom 30% -> divide by 0.7
- add burst runway 20% -> multiply by 1.2
Example for us-west (45% of 10k = 4500 qps): pick H100 int8 tps_per_gpu 180 -> eff 162 -> adjusted eff = 162 / 0.7 = 231.4 -> with burst factor 1.2 required capacity = 4500 / 231.4 ≈ 19.4 -> round up -> 20 GPUs.

Ryan (continued): full quick table: ```
region,target_qps,chosen_gpu,measured_tps,eff_tps,adj_tps,required_gpus
us-west1,4500,H100 int8,180,162,231.4,20
us-east1,3500,A100 int8,130,117,167.1,21
eu-west1,2000,A100 int8,130,117,167.1,12
(total ≈ 53 GPUs)
```

Sophie: those numbers assume uniform request size (50 tokens). For 200-token median you'd need ~0.6x the tps -> scale GPUs up accordingly. Also H100 fp16 gives lower p99 but lower tps than int8 in our runs; choose H100 int8 for cost efficiency but watch quality regressions.

Maya: what's recommended per-GPU concurrency target (concurrency = outstanding requests per GPU) to keep p99 under 250ms?

Anil: empirical targets from stress runs: H100 int8 -> target concurrency 6-8 (8 pushes near p99 240ms), H100 fp16 -> 4-6, A100 int8 -> 4-5. Set target concurrency for autoscaler to 6 for H100 pools, 4 for A100 pools. Keep an emergency throttle at 10 concurrency to avoid meltdown.

Jen: autoscale config snippet we use: ```yaml
metrics:
  - type: avg_outstanding_per_gpu
    target: 6   # H100 int8 pool override
cooldown: 120s
min_replicas: 4
max_replicas: 200
provisioning_buffer: 0.25  # start new GPUs when utilization >75%
```
(recommendation: per-pool overrides by model variant).

Sophie: kernel notes: prefer flash-attn2 on H100 for tail reduction. for A100 try inline-cuda-fused kernels we tested (driver 525+). quant caveat: int8 increased throughput but amplified small-output hallucination rate in our evals by ~1.8% — coordinate with evals team before defaulting to int8 in production.

Maya: good call. want to run end-to-end sim with traffic skew and 15 minute burst profiles. Can someone queue a sim (3-region, mixed gpu types, model q4f16 + int8 variants)? Include KV cache warmup in simulation.

Jen: I'll queue it today: job name "geo-capacity-sim-212456". ETA 6h. I'll capture p50/p95/p99, node counts over time, and a skyline chart.

Anil: we should also add routing policy: prefer local region dedicated pool, fallback to neighboring region dedicated if capacity short, then fallback to hosted at degraded quality. Will add policy draft to the sim.

Maya: action items: Jen -> run sim and attach artifact. Ryan -> produce a concise spreadsheet with the B.O.E. numbers and sensitivity (50/100/200 token). Sophie & Anil -> kernel + KV notes and recommended autoscale params. I'll consolidate and propose final GPU counts for the dedicated sell.

Ryan: acked. tagging @Jen @Sophie @Anil :thumbsup:
